decisions.reason: Premium customer support is tightly linked to the firm's core hosting and service capabilities, so its existing knowledge and service routines make it easier to refine and profit from this offer.

The software version management tool builds directly on the firm's technical platform, in-house R&D, and complementary admin tools, giving management good absorptive capacity to improve it rather than withdraw it.

The data processing contract tool is relatively distant from the firm's main hosting and operations knowledge base, so learning and further development are harder and resources are more likely to be redirected to closer products.
Scalable hosting for agencies fits the firm's customer base, infrastructure, and strategic focus extremely well, making it a natural product to retain and expand in a growing market.
